charger_ic.role: Southchip single-cell linear charger with power-path / VBUS management (I2C). Sits immediately inland of Type-C. Firmware sc7288_charger.c logs [CHG] vbus usb_enable — that is VBUS path control, not a USB 2.0 PHY. Photos mark SOUTHCHIP SC7288 (not SC7285).

soc.usb_balls: USB_DP J17 / USB_DN H17 (public BES2700BP datasheet); LDO_USB / VUSB / Avdd1p8_USB must be up for protocol

other_ics.guess: Microchip USB3740B (QFN-10) high-speed USB 2.0 1:2 mux with connector-side ESD; S / OE_N select which DP/DM pair is live

Paired small QFNs used as USB D+/D− ESD/TVS (or tiny analog switch). One pair sits left of SC7288 at the Type-C cluster; a second pair sits to the right of BES2700BP-W — classic connector-end plus SoC-end protection on a wired pair
Two identical square analog ICs inland/right of SC7288 + 3240. Secondary USB analog-switch / SEL companion candidates (not the primary mux). Not identified to a public P/N from top-mark alone
WillSemi ESD5641D07-class VBUS TVS (7 V) under the 3240 mux, protecting Type-C VBUS rather than D+/D−
CellWise CW2215 fuel gauge (firmware cw221X-fuel-gauge.c); not on the USB data path
Awinic AW883xx Class-D speaker amps (stereo pair); audio, not USB
Sensortek STK5115 capacitive-touch controller; not USB

path.summary: Type-C 2308017021 center-tongue D+/D− → ~12-part filter/ESD row above the shell → 8105 ZE01 pair → 3240 VC19 (USB3740B mux) beside SC7288 → SoC-side 8105 ZE01 pair beside BES2700BP-W USB_DP/USB_DN. USB-C, charger, mux, and SoC share the same temple PCB; B2B/flex (421P and neighbors) carry display/audio/sensor off-board, not the D+/D− pair.
path.flex_b2b: B2B marked 421P plus additional gold B2B near USB-C (board_picture/5136g16926lh1.jpeg) and speaker/mic-side B2B (board_picture/af5dhu5a26lh1.jpeg). D+/D− do not need to leave via flex to reach BES2700BP-W.

mux_or_switch.candidate: 3240 VC19 = USB3740B HS USB 2.0 mux (primary); HVTW AAB1 pair = secondary analog-switch candidates
mux_or_switch.notes: 3240 sits immediately right of SOUTHCHIP SC7288, inland of the Type-C filter row — the USB3740B COM DP/DM face the connector and the two mux ports split charger-neighborhood vs SoC. USB3740B is gated by OE_N (high = Hi-Z) and S (port 1 vs port 2). HVTW AAB1 twins sit further inland in the same cluster and could be extra analog switches or LDOs; they are not required to explain a mux in the path. SC7288 is a VBUS linear charger: it can still steal or clamp DP/DM only if a BC1.2 tap exists on one mux port, but it is not a charge-only dead-end (operator asserts the pair is wired through).

conclusion: Given wired Type-C D+/D− through the 3240/USB3740B mux to BES2700BP-W, USB protocol can still fail if LDO_USB/VUSB/Avdd1p8_USB stay off, if mux OE_N/S leave the PHY Hi-Z or parked on a charger/BC1.2 tap, if HVTW SEL is wrong, or if SC7288 VBUS usb_enable is treated as enumeration — none of those are missing tongue contacts.
